name: copy-uses-warm-step-cache-route-by-log
body: Step 2 (db.lbug removed, fact store kept) proves the cached-fact route by the log line `[scan] incremental: 0 target file(s), 5 reusable file(s)` plus the full-load-fallback reassembly line; the cobol frontend still spawns with an empty --targets list, and the test does not assert that it emits no copy records, so the kind=copy edges are attributed to splice_cached's restore of cached FragEdge properties by that zero-target evidence rather than by a direct check. Upgrade by asserting the cobol frontend emits no records for an empty target list (or that no frontend spawns on the warm route) if the restore must be proven directly.
